scope: Phoenix V3 all-app V2.14-vs-current paired scorecard
classification_unit: app_id rules; every row inherits its app_id classification and unknown app_id fails the gate
future_case_id_policy: Every scored case_id must be listed in approved_case_ids_by_app before the next full paired run starts; new case_ids under a known app_id are unclassified until a written preregistration update is reviewed.

barnes_hut.label: architecture_bearing
barnes_hut.rationale: frontier, node-coverage, and vector-accumulation work can compound across prepared execution and continuation phases

contact_manifold.label: ceiling_control
contact_manifold.rationale: current all-app rows are AABB broadphase collect-k controls; target is no added overhead unless routed through a shared AABB primitive with separate focused evidence

hausdorff_xhd.label: architecture_bearing
hausdorff_xhd.rationale: threshold-summary and exact witness routes use repeated fixed-radius/summary behavior where prepared execution and stream summaries can matter

librts_spatial_index.label: ceiling_control
librts_spatial_index.rationale: current all-app rows are AABB index count-only controls; target is parity with explanation, not broad speedup

raydb_style.label: ceiling_control
raydb_style.rationale: current all-app rows are bounded grouped count/sum controls; reusable grouped_reduction evidence remains internal but the app row should not carry the major-version speed claim

robot_collision.label: ceiling_control
robot_collision.rationale: single any-hit / collision-flag stream control; V3 must avoid overhead but should not require material speedup here

rt_dbscan.label: architecture_bearing
rt_dbscan.rationale: neighbor query plus component-union/component-signature continuation is a residency and continuation-rich workload

rtnn.label: architecture_bearing
rtnn.rationale: prepared neighbor/ranked-summary workloads can expose amortized prepared-session, packing, and continuation effects

spatial_rayjoin.label: architecture_bearing
spatial_rayjoin.rationale: multi-phase LSI/PIP/overlay/topology-stream behavior can expose prepared execution, stream, and continuation effects

triangle_counting.label: architecture_bearing
triangle_counting.rationale: prepared graph/chunk execution is the architecture-bearing part of the triangle workload

goal_level_decision_audit.decision: Freeze Set A / Set B classification before the next full all-app pod run.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: It would be foolish to run another full paired pod suite and classify rows after seeing results.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: Continue tuning routes and keep a blended geomean only. That would repeat the ambiguous 1.012x failure mode.
goal_level_decision_audit.different_path_now: Use a frozen two-number scorecard and require at least two focused material productized-path probes before spending full all-app pod time.
